subject: [PATCH v4 3/3] mm: zswap: preserve the workingset shadow across writeback

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the zswap compression algorithm where the workingset shadow is lost during writeback operations, leading to inaccurate anon refault/workingset accounting. To fix this, the patch preserves the workingset shadow within zswap by parking it in the zswap tree instead of overwriting it when allocating a new buffer folio. The parked shadow is then handled at the next opportunity, whether that's during swap-in, reclaim, or slot free operations.
